I will name the image as a vertical fine-art botanical portrait rather than starting with the figure alone, because the environment is equally important. The palette should appear immediately through muted sage, ivory, dusty rose, copper, beige, brown, olive green, turquoise, and deep royal blue.

Around her head, I build a loose romantic updo with wispy hair escaping, then thread small white blossoms and buds into it like a floral crown. On her body, I keep the strapless gown classical and Grecian in feeling, with taupe-gray-beige translucent layers, gathered drapery, visible folds, and semi-sheer material catching soft light. Along the lower-left and central foreground, I make the bouquet large and tactile, with layered rose petals, creamy clusters, tiny filler flowers, muted foliage, and irregular stems overlapping her forearms. On the right side of her face and shoulder area, I position the hummingbird in mid-hover, angled upward, with turquoise-blue iridescence, darker wing tips, a long beak pointed toward her hairline, and feet tucked beneath its body. Along the bottom and lower corners, I let extra stems, leaves, and blurred flowers frame the composition without stealing attention from the woman’s expression, the bouquet, and the bird.

Nothing in this image is meant to be read, so there is no text to set, and inventing signage would be wrong.

For the light, I choose soft directional natural illumination that seems to enter from the left front, diffused enough to avoid hard shadows. It catches the woman’s forehead, nose bridge, cheekbone, lips, collarbone, fingers, flower petals, and hummingbird feathers, leaving only mild shadow under the bouquet and fabric folds. This lighting deserves its own explicit sentence because the request emphasizes softness, glow, highlights, and subtle shadow.

I close on the whole frame by returning to balance, palette, style, and mood rather than adding new objects. The image should add up to a luxurious, painterly botanical portrait with realistic photographic detail, shallow-focus elegance, warm romance, and a quiet springtime atmosphere. The final impression is serene, ornate, editorial, and slightly fantastical, with the woman, flowers, branches, and hummingbird forming one cohesive dreamlike arrangement.
